# meca-limpia-pozo (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F9, Pozo de Kakariko (de nino)), A: both CHILD at the entrance; rooms 00 and 08 cleared, an enemy counter's key; room 01's area never.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test

# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:

#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 16-pozo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 236
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Child
#! expect A coop: test flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_00_A_Clear \(0x1215a1d0\) = 1: queued within limpia..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x1215a1d0 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia..end
#! expect A coop: test flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_08_A_Clear \(0xdd8ded5b\) = 1: queued within limpia2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xdd8ded5b \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within limpia2..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0x05d15a1e1d206e4d = 1: queued within contador..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0x5d15a1e1d206e4d \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within contador..end
#! expect A coop: test flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_01_InTheCenterArea \(0x4777f331\) = 1: queued within sensor..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0x4777f331 
mark start
warp BottomOfTheWell Well_KakarikoSide child
wait 1200               # the title screen

press A

press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)

wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark limpia
flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_00_A_Clear 1
wait 300
mark limpia2
flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_08_A_Clear 1
wait 300
mark contador

wait 300
mark sensor
flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_01_InTheCenterArea 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
